repair: One permitted infrastructure/source-clock correction; no model/settings/reference/evaluator/quality threshold change

sourceProof.meaning: Source count, integer-stride offsets, zero clearing after final available sample, full model frame duration
Global frame count includes entire trailing padded window; sanitize never clamps source duration

mapping: Compute original support from integer PCM frame count/sample rate. SDK analysis support is ceil((last integer-stride window offset + window duration)/model frame duration) * model frame duration, with Float32 endpoint rounding. Reject negative/non-finite/reversed/unproven out-of-analysis intervals. Intersect only proven zero-padded tail with original support; retain raw intervals and removed padding. All endpoints inside physical support remain identical. Do not shift/merge/relabel/repair anything inside support. Purely padded intervals are explicitly retained as excluded, not source evidence.
selectionMeaning: Research confirmation comparator only: quality cannot resolve weight lineage, recognition, confidence or product selection
gate: Unchanged version1, every development and confirmation case DER<=.20, overlap included, no collar; source validation + scoped cost also required
next: Rescore retained raw Community bspxd only. If it fails stop without more Community inference; otherwise remaining two development calls, then confirmation only if each passes.
